steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each candidate is placed by its next step and whether its stage has moved in three weeks.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Candidate with no next step
findings.fix: Set the next step this week

findings.title: Stage not moved for three weeks
findings.fix: Chase the candidate or close the stage

findings.title: Candidate with no contact date
findings.fix: Record the date of the last contact

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] cand-exec-02.md:12  Candidate with no next step.
       Fix: Set the next step this week.
[medium] cand-exec-05.md:19  Stage not moved for three weeks.
       Fix: Chase the candidate or close the stage.
[low] cand-exec-06.md:26  Candidate with no contact date.
       Fix: Record the date of the last contact.
Not checked: The candidate's view.
pros: Checks a candidate with no next step, and a stage that has not moved for three weeks.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-search-progress-report skill on the records for this review.
